scripts.package:preview: npm run build && electron-packager . 'Terminator Preview' --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --out=release --overwrite --ignore='^/(test|release|screenshots|Updates|Terminalsteroid[.]app|Terminator[.]app)' --app-bundle-id=local.terminalsteroid.preview --no-asar --icon=assets/TerminatorPreview.icns && touch 'release/Terminator Preview-darwin-arm64/Terminator Preview.app/Contents/Resources/app/PREVIEW'
scripts.install:preview: npm run package:preview && xattr -cr 'release/Terminator Preview-darwin-arm64/Terminator Preview.app' && bash scripts/install-app.sh 'Terminator Preview'
scripts.install:app: npm run package && xattr -cr release/Terminator-darwin-arm64/Terminator.app && bash scripts/install-app.sh Terminator
